title: Settings
subtitle: How things are detected, when they are logged, and where they are sent.

anki.title: Anki sentence mining
anki.noteTypeHint: Note types and fields are read from AnkiConnect. Choose a source for each note field.
anki.unavailable: Open Anki Desktop with AnkiConnect enabled to load note types.

social.title: Friends
social.share: Share what I am immersing in
social.shareHint: Mutual followers can see your current tracked work while this is enabled. Updates stop when tracking pauses or the companion closes.

game.title: Games
game.detectHint: Count active time for games linked in the library.
game.rules: Game sessions pause when the game is out of focus or you are AFK. Completed sessions go to Pending for confirmation.

mpv.configureHint: Adds input-ipc-server to the mpv.conf the player reads, after showing you exactly what changes.
mpv.prompt: {{player}} isn't sharing where the episode is, so time with the window open is being counted (pauses included). The companion can enable it in mpv.conf for you.
mpv.addBody: This line will be added to your mpv.conf:
mpv.createBody: There's no mpv.conf yet; one will be created with this line:
mpv.backupNote: A copy of the current file is kept next to it as mpv.conf.before-nihongotracker.
mpv.restartNote: mpv only reads mpv.conf when it starts: close it and open it again afterwards.
mpv.adoptBody: Your mpv.conf already opens a socket. The file won't be touched; the companion will listen there instead.
mpv.nothingBody: Everything already matches; nothing needs changing. If the position still doesn't show, close mpv and open it again.

done.add: Done. Restart mpv and the companion will read the position from {{path}}.
done.adopt: Done. The companion now listens on {{path}}.

anime.title: Anime
anime.detectHint: mpv, mpv.net, MPC-HC/BE, VLC, PotPlayer, GOM, KMPlayer, SMPlayer.
anime.usePositionHint: mpv over IPC and MPC-HC/BE over its web interface. Without it, time with the window open is counted, and a paused video counts too.
anime.mpvIpcHint: The same path as input-ipc-server in mpv.conf. On Windows it is translated to a named pipe automatically.
anime.mpvIpcHelp: Add `input-ipc-server=/tmp/mpv-socket` to mpv.conf (or set a Windows named pipe path). mpv exposes playback position over this socket so the companion can count only watched video time.
anime.mpcPortHint: Options → Player → Web Interface → Listen on port.
anime.autoLogHint: With this off, the episode waits in Pending until you approve it.
anime.logTimeHint: The site already credits 24 min per episode; turn this on only if you want the real time.

vn.title: Visual novels
vn.detectHint: Opening the executable starts the session and the texthooker.
vn.requireFocus: Only count while the window is in the foreground
vn.confirmHint: Closing the novel sends the log to Pending.

app.overlayHint: Show an always-on-top window with session controls and the latest line.
app.title: Application
app.minimizeToTrayHint: Detection keeps running with the window closed.
app.streakReminder: Warn me when my streak is at risk
app.streakReminderHint: Once a day at most, only if nothing was logged in your NihongoTracker timezone. Clicking it opens the log form.
app.streakHoursHint: Midnight in your account's timezone, not this computer's.
app.streakAtHint: Leave empty to rely on the window before midnight only.

dictionary.title: Offline dictionaries
dictionary.hint: Import a Yomitan dictionary zip. It stays on this computer and lookups work without an internet connection.

filters.title: Text filters
filters.duplicatesHint: Removes adjacent duplicate phrases within each line, such as こんにちはこんにちは → こんにちは. Keeps repeated single characters and punctuation, such as ああ……. Applies to every input source.
filters.chineseHint: For releases that hook a Chinese translation together with the Japanese, such as AIR. Drops lines with no kana that read as Chinese; names, places and other short kanji-only lines are kept. Applies to every input source, including the reading overlay.
filters.scope: These removal rules apply to LunaHook for all works. Removed text is not sent to the reader and does not count toward characters in logs. Existing lines stay unchanged.
filters.wordsHint: One entry per line. Removes every exact match, including inside dialogue. Case sensitive.
filters.regexHint: One regex per line, without / delimiters. Rules run from top to bottom before excluded words. Rust regex syntax, without lookaround or backreferences.

platform.title: Platform support

features.window_titles: Players detected by their window title
features.media_sessions: Players detected through the system media controls (MPRIS)
features.foreground: Focused window (focus-only time, game time, reading overlay)
features.actionable_notifications: “Log now” button on the streak reminder

missing.window_titles: Window titles cannot be read here.
missing.window_titles_linux: Wayland does not let apps read other windows. Players are followed through MPRIS instead.
missing.window_titles_macos: Allow Screen Recording so the companion can read window titles.
missing.media_sessions: Players are detected by their window title instead.
missing.media_sessions_linux: No D-Bus session bus was found.
missing.foreground: The focused window cannot be known here.
missing.foreground_linux: Wayland hides which window has focus, so sessions count as focused.
missing.idle: Inactivity cannot be measured, so the AFK timeout is off.
missing.idle_linux: Your compositor does not report idle time (GNOME and KDE do), so the AFK timeout is off.
missing.screenshots_linux: Window capture needs an X11 session.
missing.actionable_notifications: The reminder appears without a button; open the log form from the tray.
missing.native_hook: LunaHook injects into Windows processes. With Wine or Proton, run Textractor inside the game’s prefix and connect it over WebSocket.

platform.screenRecordingHint: macOS hides other apps’ window titles until you allow Screen Recording in System Settings → Privacy & Security. Restart the companion after granting it.

backup.title: Local database
backup.hint: Library, queue, texthooker lines, mined sentences and settings, including your API key: keep the file private. Dictionaries and screenshots are not included.
backup.confirmBody: Everything stored locally is replaced with the backup and the app restarts. Logs still waiting in the queue are replaced too. The current database is kept as companion.before-restore.sqlite3 in the app data folder.
